teaser.en: Crush a leaf of horsewood and a strong aniseed-like smell fills the air, which is how healers know they have the right plant.
teaser.sw: Ponda jani la *chinyapala* na harufu kali kama ya binzari tamu (anise) hujaa hewani; hivyo ndivyo waganga wanavyojua kwamba wamepata mmea sahihi.

summary.en: *Chinyapala* is horsewood, a shrub with strongly aromatic, gland-dotted leaves. The Digo boil its leaves for malaria, chew its twigs as toothbrushes and use its springy wood for posts.
summary.sw: *Chinyapala* (kwa Kiingereza *horsewood*) ni kichaka chenye majani yenye harufu kali, yaliyojaa vitone vya tezi. Wadigo huchemsha majani yake kwa ajili ya malaria, hutafuna vitawi vyake kama miswaki na hutumia mbao zake zinazopindika kwa nguzo.

about.en: *Chinyapala* is a shrub or small tree with compound leaves made of many small leaflets. Hold a leaf up to the light and you will see it is dotted with tiny glands, which release a strong, pungent smell when crushed. It belongs to the citrus family, and the scent shows it. Small berries ripen from red to black.
about.sw: *Chinyapala* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya mchanganyiko yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vingi vidogo. Ukiliinua jani kuelekea mwangaza utaona kwamba limejaa vitone vya tezi ndogo sana, ambazo hutoa harufu kali, inayochoma puani, linapopondwa. Ni wa familia ya michungwa, na harufu yake inathibitisha hilo. Matunda yake madogo huiva kutoka rangi nyekundu hadi nyeusi.

where.en: It grows on forest edges and in the bush.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu na vichakani.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the leaves to treat malaria, and the leaves are also brewed as a tea. Twigs are chewed into toothbrushes. The wood is strong and elastic, and it is used for posts.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha majani kutibu malaria, na majani pia hutengenezwa chai. Vitawi hutafunwa kuwa miswaki. Mbao zake ni imara na zinapindika bila kuvunjika, na hutumika kwa nguzo.

culture.en: *Pala* means gazelle, but what the full name means is unclear.
culture.sw: *Pala* ina maana ya swala, lakini maana ya jina zima haijulikani wazi.

names.en: Pakia records *chinyapala*, and ICRAF's handbook gives *mnyapala*. In Giriama it is *kathimi kapala*. In English it is horsewood. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *chinyapala*, na kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mnyapala*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *kathimi kapala*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *horsewood*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.

reason.en: Same citrus family, also used for malaria
reason.sw: Wa familia ileile ya michungwa, nao hutumika kwa malaria

reason.en: Orange climber, citrus family and malaria medicine
reason.sw: Mtambaa wa familia ya michungwa (*orange climber*), dawa ya malaria

reason.en: Toothbrush tree, also chewed for teeth
Knobwood, citrus family, used for teeth and malaria
reason.sw: Mdungu (*knobwood*), wa familia ya michungwa, hutumika kwa meno na malaria
